model_regimes.GlacioLens-GLB-v1: Selected final complete system; additional physical DEM and custom training
model_regimes.TerraMind-frozen: Released frozen encoder with trained GLB decoder
model_regimes.CROMA-frozen: Released frozen encoder with trained GLB decoder

mask.support: Apply original valid support to predictions and target

pooled_metrics: Pool int64 confusion counts before ratios; class mIoU is mean of lake/background IoU; never average tile IoUs

components.matching: Maximum cardinality then summed IoU; linear_sum_assignment maximize; eligible weight=min(ngt,npred)+1+IoU
components.complete: No image-edge contact and no 8-neighbour invalid-support contact
components.coverage: Predicted intersection / GT-component area; not IoU matching
components.false_objects: Predicted 8-connected component with zero GT overlap; report count and area separately

boundary.distance: Chebyshev tolerance2; safe support applied before dilation
boundary.aggregation: Pool matched_pred, matched_gt, pred_support, gt_support, then precision/recall/F1

empty_conventions.pooled: No undefined class unions in this cohort
empty_conventions.boundary: null if either pooled support is absent; zero if both supports exist but no matches
empty_conventions.size_groups: Empty groups carry zero counts; no invented rate

bootstrap.resampling: Equal-unit multinomial multiplicities, size=n_units, common draw across models
bootstrap.group_order: np.unique sorted Unicode strings; explicit group_index in group_mapping.csv
bootstrap.regime_initialization: Reset default_rng(56043) independently for tile and filename_source_group
bootstrap.numeric_types: int64 confusion sums and multiplicities; float64 metric ratios
bootstrap.confidence_scope: Conditional composition of fixed retained predictions; not training-seed variance or independent geography

paper_scalar_rows: Published selected-fine-tuned Cryo-Bench TableVIII-B rows remain external cited values; no masks or paired CIs are fabricated for those rows
